0022600033.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-6, 0-2 at home) host the San Antonio Spurs (5-2, riding a five-game win streak) in a West Group C Emirates NBA Cup game, with the Kings currently 15th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Pacific, while the Spurs sit 6th in the West and 1.5 games back in the Southwest. The Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Daeqwon Plowden (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and the Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). Sacramento trails the season series 0-1 after losing 130-103 in San Antonio on October 27, and the Kings were swept 0-3 by the Spurs in 2025-26.
